relation_to_constructed_G4.no_second_G4: this is an internal transverse output of the same theta-history source, not a comparison with any old realization

remaining_RH_gate: prove a source-derived conservative/positive boundary law forcing every transmission zero of R_Xi onto the fixed seam; this is the confinement theorem and is not implied by the determinant identity
conclusion: Prior history formulas already construct the desired finite-boundary Rosenbrock pencil and identify its transmission determinant exactly with Xi. The spectral-identification problem is closed at the triangular theta-history level. The substantive remaining theorem is conservative positivity/confinement of its transmission zeros.
